evidence: Carries the Mining label, implements memory tracking in `BlockTemplateManager`, and updates the mining interface.
rationale: Enables external mining clients to monitor and mitigate memory exhaustion caused by templates pinning evicted mempool transactions. According to the PR description, external clients can hold templates indefinitely, and this change provides the visibility required by Stratum v2 template providers (sv2-tp#63) to prune stale templates.
